label: List instance infra
description: List every existing copy of one infra node (the shared one, and each instance's copy of a `@per_instance` node) with its state, to see which instance has what running or find copies to stop.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

outputs.name: copies
outputs.description: One entry per copy: `{ node, instance?, status, failure? }`. `instance` is absent on the shared copy; `status` as in InstanceInfraStatus (never `none`); `failure` says why it failed.

outputs.name: instances
outputs.description: The instances that have a copy, whatever its state.

then.message: ListInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
